mapper.update: UPDATE PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL SET PRJCT_TP = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_TP ELSE #{prjctTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , PRJCT_STAT_TP = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctStatTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctStatTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_STAT_TP ELSE #{prjctStatTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , PRJCT_DPLY_TP = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctDplyTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctDplyTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_DPLY_TP ELSE #{prjctDplyTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , PRJCT_VRFC_TP = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctVrfcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctVrfcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_VRFC_TP ELSE #{prjctVrfcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , PRJCT_CPTB_TP = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctCptbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctCptbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_CPTB_TP ELSE #{prjctCptbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , USE_YN = ( CASE WHEN (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN USE_YN ELSE #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , PRJCT_NM = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_NM ELSE #{prjctNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , PRJCT_STRT_DT = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctStrtDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctStrtDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_STRT_DT ELSE TO_DATE(#{prjctStrtDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END ) , PRJCT_END_DT = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_END_DT ELSE TO_DATE(#{prjctEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END ) , PRJCT_DESC = ( CASE WHEN (#{prjctDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{prjctDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN PRJCT_DESC ELSE #{prjctDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , ETC = ( CASE WHEN (#{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN ETC ELSE #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) , UPDT_SEQ = ( CASE WHEN (#{updtSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{updtSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) THEN UPDT_SEQ ELSE #{updtSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} END ) , UPDT_NM = ( CASE WHEN (#{updtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{updtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN UPDT_NM ELSE #{updtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (PRJCT_SEQ = #{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (PRJCT_CD = #{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
mapper.delete: UPDATE PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL SET USE_YN = 'N' , DELT_YN = 'Y' , DELT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) , DELT_SEQ = ( CASE WHEN ( #{deltSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{deltSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) THEN DELT_SEQ ELSE #{deltSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , DELT_NM = ( CASE WHEN ( #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN DELT_NM ELSE #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (PRJCT_SEQ = #{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (PRJCT_CD = #{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))

UPDATE PRJ_SITE_PRJCT_MAP SET USE_YN = 'N' , DELT_YN = 'Y' , DELT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) , DELT_SEQ = ( CASE WHEN ( #{deltSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{deltSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) THEN DELT_SEQ ELSE #{deltSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , DELT_NM = ( CASE WHEN ( #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN DELT_NM ELSE #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (PRJCT_SEQ = #{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{chnlSiteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlSiteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (CHNL_SITE_SEQ = #{chnlSiteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (SRVC_SEQ = #{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}))
mapper.select: SELECT ( CASE WHEN (COUNT(BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CD) > 0) THEN true ELSE false END ) AS DUP_FLAG FROM PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL BASE_PRJCT WHERE 1 = 1 AND BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CD = #{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CD , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_TP ) AS BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DPLY_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_DPLY_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DPLY_TP ) AS PRJCT_DPLY_TP_NM , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_VRFC_TP , ( PRJCT_STRT_DT , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRJCT_END_DT , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CNCL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRJCT_CNCL_DT , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CNCL_RSN , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DESC , BASE_PRJCT.ETC , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , BASE_PRJCT.RGST_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , BASE_PRJCT.UPDT_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.UPDT_NM , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.DELT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS DELT_DT , BASE_PRJCT.DELT_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.DELT_NM FROM PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL BASE_PRJCT WHERE 1 = 1 AND BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ != 0 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND BASE_PRJCT.DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{prjctTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_TP = #{prjctTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prjctStatTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctStatTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_STAT_TP = #{prjctStatTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prjctDplyTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctDplyTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DPLY_TP = #{prjctDplyTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prjctVrfcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctVrfcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_VRFC_TP = #{prjctVrfcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prjctCptbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctCptbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CPTB_TP = #{prjctCptbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{prjctNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_NM LIKE '%' || #{prjctNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')) AND (((#{prjctStrtDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctStrtDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_STRT_DT >= TO_DATE(#{prjctStrtDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND (((#{prjctEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_END_DT <= TO_DATE(#{prjctEndDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND (((#{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.ETC LIKE '%' || #{etc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')) ORDER BY BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ ASC

SELECT BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CD , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_TP ) AS PRJCT_TP_NM , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_STAT_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_STAT_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_STAT_TP ) AS PRJCT_STAT_TP_NM , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DPLY_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_DPLY_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DPLY_TP ) AS PRJCT_DPLY_TP_NM , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_VRFC_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_VRFY_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_VRFC_TP ) AS PRJCT_VRFC_TP , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CPTB_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'PRJ_PRJCT_CPTB_001' AND CD = BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CPTB_TP ) AS PRJCT_CPTB_TP_NM , BASE_PRJCT.USE_YN , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_NM , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_STRT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRJCT_STRT_DT , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRJCT_END_DT , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CNCL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRJCT_CNCL_DT , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CNCL_RSN , BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_DESC , BASE_PRJCT.ETC , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , BASE_PRJCT.RGST_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , BASE_PRJCT.UPDT_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.UPDT_NM , TO_CHAR(BASE_PRJCT.DELT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS DELT_DT , BASE_PRJCT.DELT_SEQ , BASE_PRJCT.DELT_NM FROM PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL BASE_PRJCT WHERE 1 = 1 AND BASE_PRJCT.DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ = #{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (BASE_PRJCT.PRJCT_CD = #{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))

SELECT DISTINCT SITE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.SRVC_SEQ , PRJCT.PRJCT_CD , CHNL.CHNL_CD , SITE.SITE_CD , SRVC.SRVC_CD , SITE_PRJCT.USE_YN , SITE_PRJCT.DELT_YN , PRJCT.PRJCT_NM , CHNL.CHNL_NM , SITE.SITE_NM , SRVC.SRVC_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_PRJCT.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SITE_PRJCT.RGST_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_PRJCT.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SITE_PRJCT.UPDT_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.UPDT_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_PRJCT.DELT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MS') AS DELT_DT , SITE_PRJCT.DELT_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.DELT_NM FROM PRJ_SITE_PRJCT_MAP SITE_PRJCT LEFT OUTER JOIN SVC_SITE_SRVC_MAP SITE_SRVC ON SITE_SRVC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND SITE_SRVC.CHNL_SITE_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ AND SITE_SRVC.SRVC_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.SRVC_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CMN_CHNL_SITE_MAP CHNL_SITE ON CHNL_SITE.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SITE_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ LEFT JOIN CMN_CHNL_INFO_TBL CHNL ON CHNL.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CHNL.CHNL_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SEQ LEFT JOIN CMN_SITE_INFO_TBL SITE ON SITE.USE_YN = 'Y' AND SITE.SITE_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.SITE_SEQ LEFT JOIN SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL SRVC ON SRVC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND SRVC.SRVC_SEQ = SITE_SRVC.SRVC_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL PRJCT ON PRJCT.USE_YN = 'Y' AND PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_PRJCT.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND SITE_PRJCT.DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (PRJCT.PRJCT_CD = #{prjctCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CHNL.CHNL_CD = #{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE.SITE_CD = #{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC.SRVC_CD = #{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))

SELECT DISTINCT SITE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.SRVC_SEQ , PRJCT.PRJCT_CD , CHNL.CHNL_CD , SITE.SITE_CD , SRVC.SRVC_CD , SITE_PRJCT.USE_YN , SITE_PRJCT.DELT_YN , PRJCT.PRJCT_NM , CHNL.CHNL_NM , SITE.SITE_NM , SRVC.SRVC_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_PRJCT.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SITE_PRJCT.RGST_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_PRJCT.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SITE_PRJCT.UPDT_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.UPDT_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_PRJCT.DELT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS.MS') AS DELT_DT , SITE_PRJCT.DELT_SEQ , SITE_PRJCT.DELT_NM FROM PRJ_SITE_PRJCT_MAP SITE_PRJCT LEFT OUTER JOIN SVC_SITE_SRVC_MAP SITE_SRVC ON SITE_SRVC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND SITE_SRVC.CHNL_SITE_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ AND SITE_SRVC.SRVC_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.SRVC_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CMN_CHNL_SITE_MAP CHNL_SITE ON CHNL_SITE.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SITE_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ LEFT JOIN CMN_CHNL_INFO_TBL CHNL ON CHNL.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CHNL.CHNL_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SEQ LEFT JOIN CMN_SITE_INFO_TBL SITE ON SITE.USE_YN = 'Y' AND SITE.SITE_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.SITE_SEQ LEFT JOIN SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL SRVC ON SRVC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND SRVC.SRVC_SEQ = SITE_SRVC.SRVC_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_INFO_TBL PRJCT ON PRJCT.USE_YN = 'Y' AND PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ = SITE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND SITE_PRJCT.DELT_YN = 'N' AND SITE_PRJCT.PRJCT_SEQ = #{prjctSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND SITE_PRJCT.CHNL_SITE_SEQ = #{chnlSiteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND SITE_PRJCT.SRVC_SEQ = #{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
